unsupported_interpretations: System-A should perform the action of adding System-B to their downstream systems, and then allow System-C to subscribe.
First, ensure that System-A has added System-B to their downstream systems; only then can System-C subscribe.

ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text does not provide direct evidence to support one interpretation over the other.
